routed_to: E48 (sibling: make check_lever_reachability fail when atr_stop_mult/tp_r moved since measured_at)
what: [health] A lever-reachability measurement silently expires when the leg's geometry moves, and the guard cannot see it. check_lever_reachability.py pins the registry `arm_r` to config -- 'changing an arm without re-measuring FAILS' -- but cap_R = 0.099/(atr_stop_mult*ATR/entry) and the real ceiling is min(cap_R, tp_r), so BOTH those inputs move the answer while arm_r sits still and CI stays green. TWO LIVE INSTANCES on 2026-09-22, in opposite directions: trend_donchian_sol_4h (atr_stop_mult 2.5 -> 1.5 made an 'inert on 0 of 16' arm reachable on 11.8%) and scha_trend_long_1d (tp_r 50.0 -> 1.5 made an '83.1% reachable' arm inert). A THIRD, smaller species from the same commit: xrp_pullback_2h and qqq_trend_long_1d now carry `trail_decay_tight_mult` with no arming condition at all -- a declared tightening that can never apply, left in place because removing it was not what was decided.
